sense.text:
“There is no new thing under the sun.” Watch the news: what just happened in Venezuela, what is happening in Iran right now, what is happening in Africa right now. None of it is new. America has been doing this for over a hundred years, and it will not be over until Christ comes and takes them down. Some of you Christians think you are going to pray it away. No, it is not going to be over.

One thing to know about this place called America: America pushes laws, but America does not respect any laws. America is what you call a bully.

And every government America has overthrown, it never overthrew without somebody on the inside. There is always a traitor. Maduro is no different and Venezuela is no different. “The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be.”

“Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted”: whom I trusted. Every one in this room and every one online has somebody they trusted, and it is your most trusted advisers who betray you. It is all over history. Look at what just happened in Burkina Faso: men he trusted tried to overthrow him and kill him.

Malcolm X was shot and killed in Manhattan by three members of the Nation of Islam. He was part of the Nation of Islam; he was betrayed by the same people he trusted. Patrice Lumumba and Joseph Mobutu began as a close alliance, two young nationalists working for Congolese independence, and it turned into the betrayal that led to Lumumba’s downfall and assassination. That is the person you trusted. It was his friend, and he wanted the power. Thomas Sankara was betrayed by Blaise Compaoré, the man who betrayed his best friend, because of power and money promised to him by France.

Every leader America and the European countries have killed or overthrown fell by an enemy within. They do not just walk in and overthrow; America does not work like that. The CIA goes in, buys people, offers them money, offers them everything to betray their friend. Nothing is worse than a betrayal.

So don’t sleep: it will happen here too. Esau is not going to walk through these doors, because Esau already knows we don’t accept Esau here. Who is he going to use? The man sitting right next to you. Your wife sleeping in your bed. The children you raised. Your husband. Your so-called best friend who is in and out of your house. Those are the ones who will come to you and say, why are we teaching the Bible, why can’t we just buy some guns and overthrow Esau, and he is wearing a wire. Any man who comes saying that, the leaders are to throw him out immediately. It is a setup. You don’t know a negro mindset, what a negro is capable of. Not everybody who sits here believes.

“Which did eat of my bread”: my own familiar friend, the one who ate at my table.

This is history, and black people are quick to forget history. The white man never forgets. He repeats the past again and again, because if it isn’t broken he doesn’t try to fix it: if it has worked for over a hundred years, why change it? The problem with the negro is he thinks the white man has changed. A dumb philosopher, a dumb Bible scholar, and above all a dumb black Christian: a black Christian is the worst thing that ever happened to black people, and makes the black community ten times worse.

“And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel”: certain, not all of them. And it was not overnight. You do not convince two hundred and fifty men to follow you overnight. There is no place America ever just walked in and overthrew; the CIA gets people on the inside to cooperate, offers them big money, flies their children here and there. What happened in 2018 was not overnight either: that demon was going to the Bishop’s house for years, recording him while he did not know it. The man eating your food is not going to betray you overnight. He has not eaten enough of your food yet.

“Two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly”: princes, the top men. How long does it take to convince two hundred and fifty princes to betray the Most High God? They thought they betrayed Moses. No, they betrayed God, because the Most High sent Moses. So when a traitor rises among us, he has not betrayed us; he has betrayed the Most High God, because we are doing the work of the Most High and were sent by the Most High.

“Famous in the congregation, men of renown”: famous, known. The people knew what family these men belonged to, and they trusted them. These men knew the law. The twelve tribes knew who they were; they always had the best garments and the long fringes.

“And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you”. Here comes the flattery. Today it sounds like: Captain, you’re a better teacher than the Bishop; officer, you’re the best teacher in Israel.

“Seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the Lord is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the Lord?” Moses never said the congregation was not holy, and never said the Most High was not among the children of Israel. They came with flattery: Moses, you are not the only one the Most High is with. We hear that today: we can have multiple hoes, the Most High is with all of us; the Most High is not only working with IUIC, brother, you don’t have to fellowship, you can stay at home, the Most High is working with all of us.
“Even to morrow the Lord will shew who are his”: the Most High was going to show who belongs to him.

“Seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the Lord, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?” Is it a small thing to you that the Most High chose you to do his work? With a covetous spirit they wanted a higher position, to be the top man in charge. They were not satisfied with their position.

Some of you have no idea the position you hold. These were the top two hundred and fifty men, and they were still not satisfied. They wanted more power, more fame, more money, more glory, and that is why they could betray the Most High God so quickly. It will be some here and some online, as it was some in 2018: they want money, they see how big IUIC is, they think these men are stopping them from making money, so they try to destroy the whole thing. Isn’t that what just happened in Venezuela? And it has happened over and over again.

“Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.” Moses told the Most High not to receive any of their offering. He had taken nothing from these men.
“And Korah gathered all the congregation against them”: against Moses and Aaron.

“Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.” The Most High wanted to get all of them; everybody had to go. Moses pleaded with him not to destroy the whole congregation: “shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?” It was only a couple of men, not the whole congregation of Israel.
“And the elders of Israel followed him”: the elders followed Moses.

“And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.” God killed every one of them that day. They “went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them”: God buried them alive. That is a horrible death.

“And there came out a fire from the Lord, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.” The Most High burned the two hundred and fifty princes. Sometimes the only way to fix a negro, you have to burn him: to bring fear, you burn the one standing next to him, and when he sees him go up in fire, then he is afraid. The only thing that can fix the black Christian church in America today is fire, because some of our people are no damn good.

That spirit is among us today, just waiting. The negro who stands in the dark collecting phone numbers and names, calling people, acting like their friend, inviting them to his house to play pool and play chess, and when the time comes he hands you over. Some of those were among us in 2018. Lumumba and Sankara were put to death by their best friends for the dollar and for power, and if you think it is not going to happen here, it is already happening. They have people in our midst right now.

“For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it”: it was not the enemy that set me up, or I would have been ready, because I know who the enemy is. It was the man I trusted, the man I hang out with and go fishing with. That is why I wasn’t ready. He took me by surprise. That is what David is saying.

“Neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me”: it was not the enemy who hated Thomas Sankara that brought him down. It was his best friend; they grew up together. David is telling you, do not fall asleep. “Then I would have hid myself from him”: I would have got myself ready.
“But it was thou, a man mine equal”: an officer just like me, an officer of ten like me, an officer of twenty, of fifty like me. “My guide, and mine acquaintance.”

“We took sweet counsel together”: Deacon, I need some counsel. Captain, what do you think about this? Officer, what do you think? Every Sabbath there is a table where the officers counsel the people. But while he was taking counsel, he was plotting. Some are plotting to take your wife: why does this brother have such a beautiful wife, she is too beautiful for him, he doesn’t deserve her. Some are plotting to take your position, your job: you brought him into the company, and he went to the white man and said, you are not doing a good job, I can do better, give me his position. Then the white man has you train him, and when the time comes, boom.

“And walked unto the house of God in company.” This is the house of God. I pick him up every Saturday for Sabbath, every Wednesday for 101, every Sunday for Patient Saint Radio. We congregate together. But when he comes to betray, he has no problem betraying me.

“But the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.” That last part is the point. The man betrays you with a kiss.

Today we don’t come and kiss each other like that, but we greet each other: Shalom, Captain, Most High bless. That greeting from the man who is plotting against you: that is the betrayal. We saw that in 2018. A man who had been in another man’s house, shalom, Most High bless, let’s barbecue together, let’s travel together, showed up at that man’s house, took all his furniture, and put his children on the cold floor to sleep. He didn’t give a damn. Nothing is worse than a traitor.

And some of you think that once you have betrayed your brother or your sister, you are safe. Once they are done with you, they get rid of you too.

precepts.why:
A good precept for that verse, one some of you forget: “Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?” Judas betrayed Christ with a kiss.

That is “the kisses of an enemy”: the man betrays you with a kiss.

sense.text:
“Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother”: don’t trust any brother. “For every brother will utterly supplant”: supplant means to betray; they are plotting. We know they are planning against us right now. We are not stupid. They come to our doors asking, can we fellowship with you, can every camp get together? No, we good. First of all, we don’t believe the same thing, and we already know what you are planting. That is never going to happen.

“And every neighbour will walk with slanders”: many Israelite camps say, IUIC has too many people, and one way to destroy it is to slander the members and slander the top leadership. With black people you don’t need proof; they believe anything, and the enemy knows it. So on social media they call us all types of names, power rangers. They slander the Bishop, the Deacon, the Captain every chance they get, and then think we are going to come together with them.

“And they will deceive every one his neighbour”: they deceive their own members. “And will not speak the truth.” These brothers are Esau in black skin. “They have taught their tongue to speak lies”: everything that comes out of their mouth is a lie.

“And they whom I loved are turned against me.”

Maduro was taken by his own: members of his personal security detail, elite bodyguards handpicked for their loyalty and trained to take a bullet for him, took American money instead and handed him over. Those are light-skinned negroes, our people from Venezuela, the Northern Kingdom. He had many safe houses and the location changed often, so how did America know which house he would be in that night, at that hour? The Delta Force did not fight their way in; they walked in. The guards were told to stand down, the cameras and alarms were turned off, and the last two bodyguards surrendered without firing a shot. It is the same as when they killed Jovenel Moïse in Haiti: not one bullet fired by his guards. You were paid to protect him, and by the time anyone knew he was missing he was in Esau’s territory, because you sold him out.

It was planned for more than a year. Esau does not just walk into an ambush and take leaders. The CIA studied his guards, who were paid in worthless money while the top men lived in luxury. That is a big problem. The Bishop always says a country’s military and police are what hold the country together: the military keeps enemies out and the police keep peace inside, so they are the ones you must make sure are happy. The white man knows that, and black leaders do not understand it. It is greed.

One guard turned because he watched others promoted over him by family connections. That spirit is here too: why is he a captain, I know more scripture than him; why is he an officer of fifty when I am only an officer of ten; why do these young men always travel with the Bishop? Maybe the young man wants it more than you. The young men thirst for the word of God, know they don’t know everything, and want the Bishop’s knowledge. You say, he can’t teach me anything, I know it all. Mark my word: you are going to be the next traitor if you don’t fix that spirit.

Iraq, Libya and Haiti were thriving countries before the US invasion, and look at them after: that is where Venezuela is heading, the message to those in Venezuela who are celebrating. This is what God said about Esau.

“Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness”. The name in this verse is Esau, the so-called white man. No matter where the white man shows up you will see evil, destruction and poverty there. If you think Venezuela’s oil is going to benefit you, you are more stupid than I thought: Iraq has oil too, and you see what happened to Iraq. The white man shows up with disease, rape, guns, total destruction.

Esau does not change. Donald Trump is the proof that the white man does not change; they remember their nature. You cannot change the nature of a snake; it was created to bite you, poison you, kill you. That is the white man. That is why some go marry them and have kids by them, with the mindset, I can change this beast. You cannot change a pig. You can shower a pig, put lotion on a pig, put the best suit on a pig, and he is still a pig and will die a pig. They were created for that purpose.

And do not underestimate this place. This is Babylon the Great, with the best weapons and the best technology. China will never take America down. Nine countries have nuclear weapons; take out America and Israel, which are the same, and Russia, China, France, the United Kingdom, India, Pakistan and North Korea combined cannot take America out. Of the 193 countries in the United Nations, only five permanent members have power, and the other four cannot vote America out. When Amalek, the so-called Jews, were killing the Palestinians, all the nations condemned it and America voted them all down. America does not submit to any laws; it has a law for white people and a law for black people, and regime change after regime change, Cuba, Iran, Guatemala, Chile, Iraq, Haiti, Libya, and every Republican and Democrat president holds the same seat. It is going to take the black Messiah, Christ himself, to take this place out.
“Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me”. God wants us to remember the former things of old: the history.

“Declaring the end from the beginning”: only God can do that. “And from ancient times the things that are not yet done”: the prophecy that has not happened yet. “Saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure”. Where do you find God’s counsel? The Bible. Whatever the scripture says is going to happen; the prophecy is going to happen. Forget the dumb pastors and dumb Christians who don’t know anything: God says his counsel shall stand.
“Shall a trumpet be blown in the city”: the trumpet is the Bible. “Shall there be evil in a city, and the Lord hath not done it?” There is evil in America.

“Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.” We are the prophets. Our job is to prepare our people for what is coming. Our job is not to pick up guns and knives thinking you can do something to the white man. Our job is to bring the people back to the Most High, to prepare the mind of our people for the second coming of Jesus Christ, the black Messiah, and to reveal the Bible plainly to our people so they may repent. That is the only job.

This is for the crazy, delusional brothers: wait on the Lord. You are not going to pick up a gun or a knife and do anything to this man. This man will wipe you out just like that.

“Come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the Lord our God.” We are Zion. Our job is to declare in Zion the work of the Lord: what is coming, and how to prepare yourself for it. Fix your spirit. Build yourself up. The black Messiah is coming.

Don’t get caught up in foolishness. To our brothers and sisters in Venezuela the message is: repent. You cannot stop the white man; let them do what they were supposed to do in the first place. Our job is to prepare for the second coming of Christ. Come out of these churches and stop getting fooled by your pastors.

“And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars”: we see that today, and we have to make it plain to our people what is about to happen. “See that ye be not troubled”: don’t be troubled by that. “For all these things must come to pass”: if you want salvation, if you want to see the return of Christ, these things have to come to pass. “But the end is not yet.”

Right now Trump is turning against the northern kingdom; they are on the front line. Don’t think they are not coming after the southern kingdom, the dark-skinned negroes, us. Some of us they are going to put to death, and they are going to use the man smiling next to you, Shalom, Most High bless: they will pay him to set you up. You totally underestimate what this white man is capable of.

“For nation shall rise against nation”: are we seeing that right now? Yes. Donald Trump already told you Cuba is next, Panama is next, Greenland is next. When this snake tells you something, believe it. They snatched Maduro out of his own home, with military men and weapons around him, and put him in a tracksuit. Imagine how easy it will be when they come to do evil to us, with your butter knife or your little gun with six bullets you don’t even know works. “And kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.”

“For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation”: that is America. “Which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs.” America walks into other people’s land to possess what is not theirs.

You come into my house, take my leader, and then say Venezuela will turn over thirty to fifty million barrels of oil, and the money will be controlled by me. They said the same thing to Iraq and to Libya: we will sell the oil, we will rebuild the country. If the people of Venezuela think that money is coming back to them, they are more stupid than the white man thought. Stop being a damn fool. When the scripture calls Esau the devil, you have no idea what that means.

“He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him”. Venezuela is a peaceful country. America has had an embargo and sanctions on Venezuela for twenty years. That is how America does it: before they change a government, they destroy the economy. The money goes down, everything goes down, and twenty years later they say, he is a drug dealer, people of Venezuela, we can change your lives. They did that.

Only a simple person believes it was about drug trafficking. Trump pardoned the biggest drug dealer a couple of months before this, and Mexico, on America’s border, has more drug cartels than any place in the world. Now the case has shifted to oil. They use the same stupidity because they know some black people will believe that garbage.

“The words of his mouth were smoother than butter”: his words were like oil, but what was in his heart? 99.9 percent of what comes out of Trump’s mouth is a lie. Trump lies even when he is not talking, and every person who works for him is the same.

precepts.why:
You don’t believe it? See what God said: “The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.” The little baby is born, he can’t even talk yet, and he is looking at you lying. That is Trump: before he can say a word, he is already lying. All of them.

I didn’t say it; God said it. It is in them to be liars. They look at you and lie without blinking, and they want you to believe it, and you will, because they are white. Some think white people cannot lie. Who told you the negro is a liar? The white man. He’s right because he’s white; the negro is definitely a liar.

sense.text: “Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him”: Esau’s soul, his spirit, is not right. Esau ain’t right. “But the just shall live by his faith.”

“Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home”: he is in everybody’s business, in everybody’s home. Look at the map of 850 American bases, and there are more that have no address. Those bases are not just there; they are involved in the governments. If the leaders don’t do what America says, they use those bases to overthrow them. That is why African governments have started telling America and France to leave. France took uranium out of Niger for years, while ninety percent of the country’s roads were never built and ninety percent had no power, and France sells power to other European countries: like a man who takes everything out of your house and then lets you borrow it back if you pay him. I can do that because I have the big gun.

America is a bully, and a bully never walks alone. These countries know they cannot beat America, but they can give America a bloody nose, and that will happen. A bully only has to be given a bloody nose to think twice next time.

In Iran it is the same plan: first the embargo and sanctions destroy the economy, then the CIA inside helps raise the people up, and the media won’t tell you America destroyed the economy. It is like a man who rapes a woman and then says, I’m the good guy, I can take you to therapy. They destabilize the country and come back as the good guy, but you have to get rid of your government.

“Who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied”: death, hell, destruction, never satisfied. “But gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people”: America has all types of people here.

“Shall not all these take up a parable against him”: those same people are going to turn against this place. “Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his!” Fifty million barrels of oil: that is not America’s oil. He is destroying people and nations.

“Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?” Some think nobody can do anything to this place, but they are going to give America a bloody nose.

“Because thou hast spoiled many nations”: they have destroyed, robbed and raped many nations. “All the remnant of the people shall spoil thee”: the same thing you did to the nations, God is going to do to you. “Because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.” Every overthrow killed many people. They don’t want to tell you how many they killed in Venezuela; they bombed before they went in.
“Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house”: Esau is a covetous man.
“O virgin daughter of Babylon”: that is Esau. “There is no throne”: no more throne, no more power. “For thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.”

“But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day”: America’s judgment is going to come in one day, on the same nation that has destroyed nations for centuries. “The loss of children, and widowhood”. “For the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments”: witchcraft.

“For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness”: America trusts in its media, its weaponry, its chemical weapons. This is the most prideful man. Trump says, who is going to stop us, we have the greatest military, the greatest weapons, and he is one hundred percent right: it is not China; they have the best technology and the best weapons, and we are reading it in the Bible. The devil is right. But we Israelites know you are not powerful against the Most High, against the black Messiah.

“Thou hast said, None seeth me.” “Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee”: with their wisdom and knowledge they built these weapons, thinking they will help them in the last day. They are not going to help against Christ. “And thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.” Isn’t that what Trump said? No one can stop me; I can come into your house and take your oil, your gold, your diamonds, because I have the greatest military on the planet.

“Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth”: evil is going to come to this place, and they will not know who brings it, because they have all nations here. All the ones they have been bullying, someone will stand up and give them a bloody nose. They know they cannot stand against America one on one, so they will wait until it turns around and sucker punch it. “Thou shalt not be able to put it off”: you are not going to stop it. “And desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou shalt not know.”
“Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth”: you believe in your sorcery, your enchantments; you believe in evil.

“Woe to the bloody city!” This is the bloody city right here. “It is all full of lies and robbery”: America is full of lies and robbery. They rob all the nations, and everything that comes out of their mouth is a lie.

“The wellfavoured harlot”: America is that harlot. “The mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.” They destroy families and destroy nations, and call it democracy: we are going to bring freedom. Yet they themselves do not follow it. America is a big hypocrite. When nations brought charges against Netanyahu at the international court, America threatened sanctions on all of them and seized their assets. That court was not created for white people; it was created to judge the black nations. The white man is above the law.

“Behold, I am against thee, saith the Lord of hosts”: God is against this place, against these people. “And I will discover thy skirts upon thy face”: God is going to uncover America’s wickedness and reveal that America is a hoe, not a virgin, that America has been sleeping with everybody.

Many don’t know America has been doing the same thing for years because back then there was no internet and no cameras. They went murdering, killing and robbing, and said, who sees me? Now everybody can record and put it up, and even with the camera in front of them they say, that’s not what happened. That is how evil this man is.

“And I will shew the nations thy nakedness”: he will show the whole world how evil this place is. This man is the devil; he cannot change. What happened in Venezuela will keep happening. Pray Trump stays in office: he is speeding up the prophecy, and through that devil comes our deliverance and our salvation; through that demon our people will be free one day. “And the kingdoms thy shame.”

“For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.” They wanted us to sing. They were making fun of us.
“If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.” The Most High is not going to forget us.

“Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom”: Lord, remember the Edomites, the so-called white men. “Who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof”: destroy them, wipe all of us out. A building starts with the foundation; they want to take out the foundation and destroy us.

“O daughter of Babylon”: that is Esau, “who art to be destroyed”. “Happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.” Their reward is coming. Justice is coming to this place, and we are going to celebrate.
“Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.” That is judgment, and it is not talking about right now. It is coming.

“The Lord is a man of war”. Brothers, war is coming. Our job is to prepare for it spiritually and mentally, not physically: to prepare ourselves and prepare our people. The Bishop has been teaching for a while to keep a food pantry. Some did it; some think it is a joke and that it will never happen here. War is coming. God is bringing war to this place and to the earth, and you should be happy, not sad, because through those wars our salvation comes and our freedom comes. We should pray for it.
“For I the Lord thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.” God is talking to us: don’t be afraid. He is going to help us.
“Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the Lord, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.”

“Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument”: that is a weapon, a weapon of war. “Thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small”: the mountains are the nations. We are going to beat them small.
“And the whirlwind shall scatter them.” A time is coming when we will say, there was a place named America; what happened to America? It will be wiped out, never remembered again.

This has to be read before we go, because there are some crazy brothers. “For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh”: we walk in the physical, but we do not war after the physical. This is spiritual warfare. Get your mind right and get your mind together for the second coming of Christ.

No matter what happens in this place, do not get caught up in the foolishness. Look at what was just done to that white woman in Minnesota: if they can treat a white woman like that, imagine how they will treat us. Don’t go out there talking about, I’m going to help you march. This is not your problem. Stay in the scripture. Our job is to get our people ready for the second coming. Even your own family in the world, who tell you they hate the Most High, will call you to help with this and that; don’t get caught up in stupidity with them.
“For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds”.

“Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God”: our job is to cast down every evil imagination in the mind of our people. “And bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ”: take every evil thought captive to the obedience of Christ, the black Messiah. We are the armor of God.
